source: SharpWR editor notes, 2026-10-05. Each style's items are a build path: a build with N items holds the first N (Muramana stands for Manamune before level 11); the search fills the remaining slots from every item. A keystone replaces the champion's default keystone for that style. The editor's core item (data/editor-core-items.json) is always a style too.

Corki.note: Missile Barrage triggers Essence Reaver often.
